lines.speaker: note
lines.text: (pause)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What did he make you do Brendan? It's OK, what did he make you do?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cut her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Cut her where?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: On her throat.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Cut her throat? Te-when did that happen?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Before he picked her off the bed?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So she was alive yet right? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So she's alive and you cut her throat?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: mm huh.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was that before or after Steve stabbed her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: After.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: It was after Steve stabbed her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) mm-huh.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was she a-how do you know she was alive? (pause) Tell me. When you cut her throat, how do you know she was alive?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: She was breathing a little bit.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: She was breathing a little bit. Did Steve tell you to do that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: note
lines.text: (Fassbender and Wiegert speaking at the same time- cannot understand)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: How'd he tell you to do, how'd he tell you to do that? What'd he say?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: To go across her throat and pull it back.
